title: hidden-files
description: What was moved out of the working tree for a critic-class call of the form read-only-tools, and where it is kept. Feature 100 annex B §B.20 fixes the schema id, the logical name attempt:<N>:<k>:<n>:hidden-files and the owner (117). The fields are those of specs/117-critic-grounding-and-prompt/data-model.md; spec.md F117-FR-040 stands where they differ.

attemptId.description: The phase attempt of the call

state.description: planned: record written; hidden: files moved; returned: files back, hashes equal

logicalName.description: The logical name of annex B §B.5, as a pattern

existed.description: Whether the file existed before the call; a file that did not exist must not exist after it

from.description: Where it was, relative to the workspace root

keptAt.description: Where it is kept, relative to the location of the logical name of this record

hash.description: Hash of the content by the canonical hasher (annex X §X.5)

mtime.description: Modification time as the file system gave it

setAside.description: Where a file found at the place at the return was set aside, if one was found
